title: 大阪杯の後に・目指すは1着のみ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon dominates at the Osaka Hai! The Queen of the Amazons is better than ever, and her incredible running reflects that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She responds to the cheering audience with pride. Next on her list is winning first place at the Yasuda Kinen!
